classification.difficultyReason: Connect the three pairs of prism faces to the supplied surface-area expression, then expand and compare coefficients to obtain a+b and ab. Select the integer pair and use a>b to assign it; these are routine linked procedures with the target expression supplied.

content.prompt: A rectangular prism has width $y$ cm, length $(x+a)$ cm and height $(x+b)$ cm, where $a$ and $b$ are integers and $a>b$.

children.label: a
children.prompt:
Show that the surface area of the rectangular prism is given by the expression
$$2y(2x+a+b)+2(x+a)(x+b)\text{ cm}^2.$$

answer.worked:
The prism has three pairs of equal rectangular faces.
$$\begin{align*}S&=2y(x+a)+2y(x+b)+2(x+a)(x+b)\\&=2y\bigl[(x+a)+(x+b)\bigr]+2(x+a)(x+b)\\&=2y(2x+a+b)+2(x+a)(x+b)\text{ cm}^2.\end{align*}$$

children.label: b
children.prompt:
If the surface area of the rectangular prism is equivalent to the expression
$$2y(2x+1)+2x^2+2x-12\text{ cm}^2,$$
find $a$ and $b$.

answer.worked:
$$\begin{align*}S&=2y(2x+a+b)+2\bigl[x^2+(a+b)x+ab\bigr]\\&=4xy+2(a+b)y+2x^2+2(a+b)x+2ab.\end{align*}$$
Equating the coefficients of $y$ and the constant terms gives
$$\begin{align*}2(a+b)&=2\\a+b&=1\\2ab&=-12\\ab&=-6.\end{align*}$$
The integers $3$ and $-2$ have sum $1$ and product $-6$. Since $a>b$, $a=3$ and $b=-2$.
